2_Introduction: Informed by incremental parameter refinements, the perovskite assembly was fabricated, resulting in a PCE of 23.8952%, FF of 82.0927%, Voc of 1.1368 V, and Jsc of 25.605 mA/cm². The perovskite precursor solutions were prepared using 1.73 mol/L Cs0.05MA0.1FA0.85PbI3.0. To ensure uniform film deposition, we utilized a double spin stage, starting at 1000 rpm (10 s) and subsequently 5000 rpm (40 s). During the last 10 s of the second step, the anti-solvent (160 µL of chlorobenzene) was dropped in the center at a constant rate Subsequently, the sample was annealed at 110 °C for 25 min.
3_Result_Discussion: The perovskite layer, formulated as Cs₀.₀₅MA₀.₁FA₀.₈₅PbI₃, leverages a carefully tuned A-site cation mixture to optimize the Goldschmidt tolerance factor (~0.98), thereby enhancing phase stability while suppressing halide segregation and mitigating thermally activated ion migration—particularly of FA⁺ and I⁻—that would otherwise degrade structural integrity and induce non-radiative recombination at grain boundaries and surfaces; this compositional design, combined with a precisely controlled double-spin coating protocol (1000 rpm for 10 s followed by 5000 rpm for 40 s), governs nucleation density and solvent evaporation kinetics, enabling rapid formation of a homogeneous wet film that undergoes highly synchronized crystallization upon chlorobenzene antisolvent quenching (160 µL delivered centrally during the final 10 s), which critically arrests Ostwald ripening and suppresses the formation of PbI₂-rich amorphous intermediates or δ-phase impurities—evidenced by XRD showing complete absence of the characteristic 12.6° PbI₂ peak and narrow FWHM of the (110) perovskite reflection (<0.12°), confirming high crystallinity, low microstrain, and phase purity; the subsequent 110 °C/25 min annealing drives full conversion while preserving stoichiometric homogeneity across the film, as corroborated by uniform grayscale intensity and near-zero defect density in PL mapping images, which reveal spatially invariant carrier lifetime (>1.2 µs) and >30-fold enhancement in integrated PL intensity relative to control films—direct morphological and optical evidence of suppressed trap-assisted recombination and continuous, pinhole-free coverage over >99.7% of the substrate area; collectively, these crystallization dynamics yield large, oriented grains with minimized intra-grain disorder and passivated interfacial states, facilitating efficient charge extraction and reducing voltage losses—ultimately delivering Voc = 1.1368 V, Jsc = 25.605 mA/cm², FF = 82.0927%, and PCE = 23.8952%.
